g.text: Six shell interiors / explicit public doorways / four open court gates / furniture follows route clearance
For Blender blockout / proposed / not an as-built playable
Dimensions govern. All lengths in metres unless marked mm. Print A1 at 100%.
MAP REV 01 + DETAIL ISSUE B01 / 18 OCTOBER 2026
200 mm shell, 2.80 clear ceiling. Keep a 2.40 continuous route
between portals; use display racks/appliances around the perimeter.
Door leaves held open initially. Side service doors face Washhouse
N-side display glass: sill 0.60, head 2.20. Spans from x=0.60 to
centre-1.50 and centre+1.50 to width-0.60. Fascia and shutters are
render details; do not seal the scheduled front door.
Map origin (57,50). Fence 2.60 high; four 4.00 gates at side
midpoints. Paint rectangle inset 1.00. Mesh is visually porous;
define bullet/collision behaviour explicitly. No physics for painted
Low cover height 1.00; tall screens 2.10. Exact cover placements
stay in map.json / cover-placements.csv. Dirty edges and nets are
cosmetic; use measured box collision for rigid cover.
